target.title: fix(memory-host-sdk): resolve stable execPath for worker fork to survive Homebrew Node upgrades
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

After Homebrew upgrades Node (e.g. `node 26.3.0 → 26.4.0`), a running Gateway's `process.execPath` still points at the old deleted Cellar path (`/opt/homebrew/Cellar/node/26.3.0/bin/node`). The local embedding worker `fork()` uses this stale path and fails with `ENOENT`, silently degrading semantic memory until the gateway is restarted.

## Root Cause

`packages/memory-host-sdk/src/host/embeddings-worker.ts:236` calls `fork()` without an explicit `execPath` option. Node.js's `fork()` defaults to `process.execPath`, which resolves to the real Homebrew Cellar path — not the stable `/opt/homebrew/opt/node/bin/node` symlink. When `brew upgrade` removes the old Cellar directory, every new worker fork hits ENOENT.

## Summary

**Problem**: After Homebrew upgrades Node, the running Gateway's `process.execPath` still points at the old deleted Cellar path. The worker `fork()` uses this stale path and fails with ENOENT, silently degrading semantic memory.

**Solution**: Pre-resolve a stable Node executable path before `fork()`. When `process.execPath` matches a Homebrew Cellar pattern, resolve to the stable opt symlink that survives upgrades. On all other platforms return the original path unchanged.

What changed: New `resolveStableWorkerExecPath()` helper (module-level, exported for testing) with a promise cache. `ensureChild()` made async to call the helper before `fork()`. Re-check `this.child?.connected` after async yield to prevent concurrent restart race. New test file with 8 unit tests.

What did NOT change: Public API (`createLocalEmbeddingWorkerProvider`) signature. Package boundaries — no cross-package imports. Worker IPC protocol. Non-Homebrew platform behavior.

## Change Summary

1. **New `resolveStableWorkerExecPath()` helper** — module-level, exported for testing. Detects Homebrew Cellar paths (`<prefix>/Cellar/<formula>/<version>/bin/node`) and resolves to the stable opt symlink. Uses lazy module-scoped promise cache.

2. **`ensureChild()` made async** — calls `resolveStableWorkerExecPath()` before `fork()` and passes the resolved path via the `execPath` option.

3. **New test file** — 8 unit tests covering Cellar/non-Cellar paths, versioned formulas, opt/bin fallback, cache behavior, and API contract preservation.

### Files changed

- `packages/memory-host-sdk/src/host/embeddings-worker.ts` — core fix (+1 import, +1 async modifier, ~45 new LOC)
- `packages/memory-host-sdk/src/host/embeddings-worker-stable-execpath.test.ts` — new tests (~240 LOC)

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior addressed**: Prevent local embedding worker fork failure (ENOENT) after Homebrew Node upgrade by resolving a stable execPath before fork().

**Real environment tested**: Linux x86_64 (Node v24.1.0 via nvm). Homebrew-specific path resolution validated via unit tests with mocked fs.access. Function returns process.execPath unchanged on non-Homebrew platforms, confirming zero regression risk.

**Exact steps or command run after this patch**: Direct function call via npx tsx, regex pattern validation, unit test execution, type check. All commands executed on the Linux x86_64 environment.

L2+ Evidence: Direct function call (2026-07-03T16:59 UTC+8)

```bash
$ npx tsx demo-execpath.mjs
{
  "resolved": "/home/user/.config/nvm/versions/node/v24.1.0/bin/node",
  "durationMs": 0,
  "sameAsExecPath": true,
  "platform": "linux",
  "nodeVersion": "v24.1.0"
}
```

Regex validation (8/8 correct)

```bash
── Homebrew Cellar pattern validation ──
  ✅ /opt/homebrew/Cellar/node/26.3.0/bin/node                  → MATCH (formula=node)
  ✅ /usr/local/Cellar/node@22/22.11.0/bin/node                 → MATCH (formula=node@22)
  ✅ /opt/homebrew/Cellar/node/30.0.0/bin/node                  → MATCH (formula=node)
  ✅ /usr/local/Cellar/node@18/18.20.0/bin/node                 → MATCH (formula=node@18)
  ✅ /home/user/.nvm/versions/node/v24.1.0/bin/node             → no match
  ✅ /usr/bin/node                                              → no match
  ✅ C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe                           → no match
  ✅ /snap/node/current/bin/node                                → no match

  Results: ✅ all 8/8 correct
```

L3 Evidence: Full Gateway compilation (2026-07-03T15:16 UTC+8)

```bash
$ pnpm dev gateway
[openclaw] Building TypeScript (dist is stale, rebuilding)
[openclaw] Building bundled plugin assets...
runtime-postbuild: plugin SDK root alias completed
runtime-postbuild: bundled plugin metadata completed
...
2026-07-03T15:16:22.329+08:00 [gateway] starting...
```

Full Gateway build succeeds: TypeScript compilation, plugin asset bundling, and runtime initialization all complete without errors.

Unit tests (verbose output — 8/8 passed, 2026-07-03T16:59 UTC+8)

```bash
$ pnpm test packages/memory-host-sdk/src/host/embeddings-worker-stable-execpath.test.ts -- --reporter=verbose
 ✓ returns original path for non-Cellar execPath (/usr/bin/node)
 ✓ resolves to opt symlink when Homebrew Cellar path is detected and opt path exists
 ✓ falls back to bin symlink when opt path is absent (default node formula)
 ✓ returns original execPath when neither opt nor bin symlinks exist
 ✓ resolves versioned formula node@22 via opt symlink
 ✓ skips bin fallback for versioned formula (node@22 has no plain bin symlink)
 ✓ caches resolved path on second call
 ✓ does not break existing provider creation contract
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  8 passed (8)
```

Regression tests (19/19 passed, 2026-07-03T16:59 UTC+8)

```bash
$ pnpm test packages/memory-host-sdk/src/host/embeddings.test.ts
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  19 passed (19)
```

Type check

```bash
$ pnpm tsgo:core
[tsgo] passed
```

**After-fix evidence**: Direct function call returns process.execPath unchanged on Linux (no regression). Regex correctly matches 4 Homebrew Cellar variants and correctly rejects 4 non-Homebrew paths. All 8 new unit tests pass covering every resolution branch. All 19 regression tests pass. Type check passes. Full Gateway build succeeds.

**Observed result after the fix**: The fix deterministically resolves a stable execPath before fork(), eliminating the ENOENT failure path from stale Homebrew Cellar binaries. On non-Homebrew platforms (Linux, Windows), the function returns process.execPath unchanged — verified by direct function call with sub-millisecond latency. On Homebrew platforms, the Cellar-to-opt resolution is verified by unit tests with mocked fs.access covering all branches (opt exists, bin fallback, all absent, versioned formula, cache).

**What was not tested**: macOS Homebrew Gateway E2E with actual brew upgrade — this environment is Linux x86_64, not macOS. **macOS users with Homebrew**: if you can reproduce the ENOENT scenario on macOS, please share terminal output or logs showing the worker fork recovery after a stale Cellar path. The Homebrew-specific resolution logic is covered by unit tests (mocked fs.access). Gateway E2E with actual Node upgrade — the fix only changes execPath before fork(); the fork+IPC lifecycle is unchanged. Long-running Gateway with repeated worker restarts — cache test confirms repeat calls use the cached promise.

## Maintainer decision needed: competing fix #99222

This PR targets the same root cause and canonical issue (#99183) as an open sibling PR: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99222.

The two approaches differ:

| Dimension | This PR (#99318) | Sibling PR (#99222) |
|---|---|---|
| Strategy | Pre-resolve stable execPath before fork() | ENOENT retry after fork failure |
| Platform scope | Homebrew-specific path resolution | All platforms (retry) |
| Config surface | None — transparent to user | None — transparent to user |
| Risk | Changes `ensureChild()` to async | Adds retry logic |
| Code surface | ~45 LOC source + 240 LOC tests | Smaller |

**Both approaches are valid** — this PR prevents the failure before it happens (matches the existing `src/infra/stable-node-path.ts` pattern used by the daemon), while #99222 recovers from the failure after the fact. Maintainers should decide which approach (or a combination) should be the canonical fix for issue #99183 before landing either PR.

## Risk checklist

- [ ] **merge-risk**: Low — additive change in a single package (memory-host-sdk), no public API changes, no config changes, no dependency changes. The new helper is an internal detail that only affects one call site (`ensureChild()`). On non-Homebrew platforms the behavior is identical.
- [x] **code change is self-contained**: Yes — ~45 LOC in one file + test file
- [x] **does not affect any public API surface**: Yes — `createLocalEmbeddingWorkerProvider` signature unchanged
- [x] **does not affect any provider/auth/model/catalog code**: Yes
- [x] **does not affect any config/env/defaults surface**: Yes
- [x] **does not affect any channel/plugin/extension code**: Yes
- [x] **proof type**: L2+ (direct function call + regex validation + test output) + L3 (Gateway build)
- [x] **changelog needed**: No — internal implementation detail
- [x] **risk mitigation**: Tests cover all resolution paths; cache prevents repeated fs.access; non-Cellar paths return process.execPath unchanged; no new dependencies introduced; re-check `this.child?.connected` after async yield prevents concurrent restart race

## Test plan

| Scenario | Coverage |
|----------|----------|
| Non-Cellar path (Linux `/usr/bin/node`) | ✅ returns original path unchanged |
| Cellar path + opt symlink exists | ✅ resolves to opt symlink |
| Opt absent + bin symlink exists (default formula) | ✅ falls back to bin symlink |
| All symlinks absent | ✅ returns original execPath |
| Versioned formula `node@22` | ✅ resolves versioned formula; skips bin fallback |
| Cache hit on repeated calls | ✅ caches resolved path |
| API backward compatibility | ✅ provider creation contract preserved |
| Direct call on Linux (L2+) | ✅ returns process.execPath (no regression) |
| Regex path pattern | ✅ matches Cellar, rejects non-Cellar paths correctly |
| Full Gateway build (L3) | ✅ TypeScript compilation, bundling, runtime init all pass |
| Regression tests | ✅ all 19 existing tests pass |

## Linked context

- Fixes https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99183
- Existing stable-node-path helper: `src/infra/stable-node-path.ts`
- Competing approach: PR #99222 (ENOENT retry strategy — see Maintainer decision needed section above)
